# Data packs with invalid test instances added to a RUNNING server (`!addpack`, then `reload` / `datapack enable`), and a pack with an
# invalid predicate. A pack present at start is loaded with the dynamic registries, and a broken entry there stops the server from
# starting (the start-up error texts are recorded in the registry oracle). Test instances and test environments cannot be added
# at run time: `/reload` reloads only the reloadable registries, so the instances of gtbad are never looked at and `test` still
# finds no `gtbad:*` afterwards. A broken reloadable entry (gtbadpredicate) fails the reload and keeps the old data.
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/gametest_bad.txt
# The run time of a test (`passed! (3ms / 0gameticks)`) is the only non-deterministic output.
!datapack gametest/gtpack
!mask (\d+)ms
test run gtbad:valid
test locate gtbad:*
datapack list available
!addpack gametest/gtbad
datapack list available
reload
datapack list available
datapack enable "file/gtbad"
datapack list enabled
test run gtbad:valid
test locate gtbad:*
test run gtbad:*
test run gt:pass
!ticks 40 show
!addpack gametest/gtbadpredicate
reload
datapack enable "file/gtbadpredicate"
datapack list enabled
execute if predicate gtbadpredicate:broken
test run gt:pass
!ticks 40 show
